watch.summary: A streamer obsessively praises a pro esports player's good looks and hair while watching video clips.

beats.what: Streamer starts talking about how much he likes pro player Ethan.
Streamer focuses on Ethan's luscious hair and says he could look at him all day.
Streamer catches himself over-complimenting and calls 'hold up, pause' before justifying his praise.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I can look at Ethan all day.
watch.why: The streamer's hilarious transformation into a fanboy admiring another guy's hair creates funny comedic escalation. His sudden realization that he is 'glazing' adds a funny beat of self-awareness.
